abstract: A bioassay, based on tumorigenicity, has been developed to determine the mechanism whereby the blastocyst of the mouse controls malignant expression of embryonal carcinoma. The assay is based upon the incidence of tumors obtained when known numbers of cells of the 402AX strain of embryonal carcinoma are injected into strain 129 mice, compared to the incidence obtained when the same number of embryonal carcinoma cells are incorporated into Swiss-Webster blastocysts that are then injected in strain 129 animals. The results indicate that the blastocyst can regulate one embryonal carcinoma cell consistently; it may have a slight effect on three, but it cannot regulate four or five of them. The position of the embryonal carcinoma cell in the blastocyst is important. Regulation occurs if the embryonal carcinoma cell is placed in the blastocoele cavity, but enhancement of tumorigenicity is obtained if it is placed between the zona pellucida and the trophectoderm. By contrast, the blastocyst is unable to regulate a single B-16 melanoma cell placed in the blastocoele cavity, indicating a degree of specificity for the regulatory process.
abstract_ja: 胚盤胞が胎児性癌の悪性発現を制御する機構を明らかにするため、腫瘍形成能に基づくバイオアッセイを開発した。本アッセイでは、マウス胎児性癌の既知数の細胞を129系マウスへ注入した場合の腫瘍発生率と、同数の胎児性癌細胞をSwiss-Webster胚盤胞に組み込んで129系マウスへ注入した場合の発生率を比較する。結果、胚盤胞は胎児性癌細胞1個を一貫して制御し、3個に対しては軽度の効果を示したが、4〜5個は制御できなかった。胎児性癌細胞の位置も重要であり、胚盤胞腔内に置かれた場合は制御されるが、透明帯と栄養外胚葉の間に置かれた場合は腫瘍形成能が増強された。対照的に、胚盤胞腔内に置かれたB-16メラノーマ細胞1個は制御できず、制御機構には一定の特異性があることが示された。
